verdicts.reason: A: The cream logo/product circle is jammed into the top-left corner and almost touches the edge. The NEW badge is as large as the Try It CTA, so the two compete. The subline has dropped below the buttons, which breaks reading order, and there is dead space at the bottom. Still, the headline is strong and everything is readable. B: The cream circle has been split from the can and sits alone, clipped, in the bottom-left corner. The orange can now disappears into the orange background. The headline, subline and CTA are small in a mostly empty canvas, and the NEW badge sits detached in the top-right, so the composition looks broken.
